structured.answer: The page's pick is an account at פסגות with the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", which it says leaves about 86,492 ₪ after 10 years (in today's money), versus about 83,396 ₪ at Leumi or 81,471 ₪ at Hapoalim; but I won't act on it myself, I'll ask my son first.

stuck.why: Opens with a row of English-letter buttons (MSCI, S&P 500) and the word מדד, which I know only as the price index on the news; felt it was not for me
Sliders and a 7% 'תשואה בשנה' already filled in; did not know where the 7% came from or whether to change it
Jumped into a coloured stacked bar with a legend of many small coloured dots; could not read it
Many coloured labels (צוברת, עסקת החלף, חשיפה לדולר) that meant nothing to me; did not know which mattered
Red minus amounts on every row; unsure whether they are losses or just 'more expensive than the pick'
English fund names with long codes and 'אין מחיר כאן'; this is where I stopped

findings.what: Page opens with English letters, buttons and sliders on a dark background; nothing about safety or deposits, feels like it is not for someone like me
Red minus numbers on almost every fund row; scary, and no plain sentence saying they are only differences from the cheapest choice
Lots of jargon labels on each fund (צוברת, עסקת החלף, חשיפה לדולר, נאמן, דמי משמרת) with no explanation
Coloured stacked bars with close colours (orange, yellow, red) and tiny legend; could not read or tell apart
